name: Triton DF 16
description: Triton DF 16 (CAS 58229-81-5 ) is a low-foaming nonionic surfactant designed for applications where controlled foam profiles and strong surface activity are critical. It delivers effective wetting, emulsification, and degreasing performance across a range of industrial formulations. In home care and industrial cleaning, this surfactant is used in hard surface cleaners, machine dishwashing formulations, and CIP systems where foam suppression is a process requirement. Textile processors incorporate it into scouring and dyeing auxiliaries to improve fiber wetting and dye penetration without generating disruptive foam during the manufacturing process. Coatings and adhesive formulators use it as a wetting and dispersing agent to improve substrate adhesion and pigment distribution in waterborne systems for better finish quality. Leather and paper manufacturers apply it to ensure uniform treatment liquor penetration during processing, which enhances the overall consistency and durability of the final material. Triton DF 16 is supplied as a liquid, suitable for direct incorporation into aqueous formulations or dilution systems. It is available in technical grade , the standard specification for industrial applications. Packaging typically includes drums and IBC totes to support both mid-scale and bulk procurement requirements.
